Iteration 12 bug is fully resolved.

rca_of_issue: Iteration 12 RCA — resolved. Original bug: NOISE_PATTERNS `AT\d{10}[A-Z]{2,4}\d*` required 10 consecutive digits after 'AT', but real Shopee AT codes contain 9 digits + 4 alphanumerics (e.g. AT202607036QXO9). Fix applied by main agent: replaced with `AT[0-9A-Z]{10,14}` on server.py:199 and switched row-block cleaner (server.py:447) to `_AT_CODE_RE.sub` (which uses the same 10-14 range). Also added cliente-name strip on server.py:449-450 so customer names no longer pollute the geocoder input. Verified via POST /api/parse-text with the 3-row payload — all AT codes and names are stripped from endereco.
